newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr bond yields close flat in correction.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr bond yields close flat in correction.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed unchanged on Friday after late profit-taking wiped out early falls in the yields, dealers said.

Three-month CD yields closed lower as new issues were scanty in line with ample liquidity at banks, they said. * 3-yr corporates close unchanged at 12.25 pct * 3-mth CDs end at 12.55 pct vs Thursday's 12.60 * Average overnight call rate unchanged at 11.8 pct -------------------------------------------------------------
"Liquidity with banks will continue to be ample, but heavy new issues and profit-taking would keep the yields from falling sharply next week," said Song Duk-kee of Dongsuh Securities.
Dealers said next week's new corporate bond issues were estimated at 800 billion won, compared with between 500 billion and 600 billion won during recent weeks.
Three-month CD yields closed lower as new issues were scanty due to the ample liquidity at banks, dealers said.
